requirements.title: Shortcut Profile Storage
requirements.description: Shortcut profiles stored in-memory with service/workspace/parent scope hierarchy. API supports CRUD for shortcut profiles with scope-based resolution.

validation.notes: Test CRUD operations for profiles — shortcut_profiles_test.go (16 tests) + shortcut-profiles.test.ts (8 tests)

requirements.title: Shortcut Profile Management UI
requirements.description: TerminalLauncher fetches effective shortcuts from API on open, falling back to DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS. Scope hierarchy resolution happens server-side.

validation.notes: Terminal launcher fetches effective shortcuts from the API and falls back to defaults on failure
All shortcuts configurable via PUT /api/v1/shortcuts/profiles — API CRUD tests
SettingsPage renders profiles, dirty tracking, save/delete/create, error recovery with refetch

requirements.title: Fallback Shortcut Resolution
requirements.description: When API shortcut fetch fails, launcher falls back to DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS defined in consts/shortcuts.ts without error display.

validation.notes: Default shortcuts exported with correct entries
